IRON YARD — one owner-authorized PUBLIC Roblox update, 12 November 2026.

Owner requested continuing improvements to the existing PUBLIC IRON YARD FPS.
This single release includes PR #36, squash commit
eb9bcf3756f380e5727c6e30f9105ee873d9183f.
Transient VFX now skip repeated Part.Size property writes when size stays
constant. Each pooled FX slot recalculates its size-change classification
on spawn, so recycled brass, muzzle flash, tracers and hit glints retain
correct original geometry, animations, opacity, and priority. The client
pool remains bounded, server-authoritative combat and gameplay unchanged.
Luau regression, source contracts and Rojo build passed on the PR and
on merged main.

Require a fresh green full CI for the exact authorization commit before
one-shot release. The guarded public publisher must verify exact commit,
owner, intended existing PUBLIC universe and root place. Do not create
a new experience or claim measured Android FPS. No secrets in source.
